recognize_zh: 這是存活曲線圖而非形態圖：上圖 DNMT3A 或 NPM1 突變、或 MLL 易位者，高劑量 daunorubicin 的整體存活明顯優於標準劑量（P=0.001）；下圖野生型者兩組無差異（P=0.67），下方表格列出3年存活率。
features: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves, not a morphologic image
Top panel: mutant DNMT3A or NPM1, or MLL translocation; high-dose curve above standard-dose (P=0.001)
Bottom panel: wild-type DNMT3A and NPM1 without MLL translocation; overlapping curves (P=0.67)
Numbers at risk listed below each plot
Summary table: 3-year OS 44% vs 25% in the mutant group; 35% vs 39% in all other genotypes
describe_en: This figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) presents Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves comparing high-dose versus standard-dose daunorubicin induction in AML according to genotype. Patients with DNMT3A or NPM1 mutations or MLL (KMT2A) translocations had significantly improved survival with high-dose therapy (3-year OS 44% versus 25%, P=0.001), whereas patients lacking these lesions derived no apparent benefit (35% versus 39%, P=0.67). The figure illustrates the use of molecular profiling to predict response to dose-intensified induction. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
